card.name: Start of tenofovir and teniposide
card.fires_on: The word start "ten" at the beginning of drug names such as tenofovir and teniposide, usually in drug lists or interaction text. It also fires on "Ten" in "Tenants in Common".

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: The first piece "ten" of tenofovir or teniposide in lists of drugs or interaction warnings.
modes.example: raltegravir, ribavirin, rilpivirine,<< ten>>ofovir disoproxil f

modes.label: Legal term
modes.description: "Ten" starting the word tenants in a property-law glossary.
modes.example: A person occupying property or land under tenancy or Lease. <<Ten>>ants in Common Opposite of Joint

card.writes: It promotes words for minute and time, which seems unrelated to the drug-name pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
